description: Generate the printable order-details PDF for a single lunch date. Note this is one date, not a range, and studentIds is required — the endpoint fails if it is empty, or if no order matches the date and status you ask for. Get both from mhlb_get_calendar.

date.description: The lunch date to report on (YYYY-MM-DD).

inline.description: Return the PDF as base64 in the result instead of writing it to a file. Default false.

orderStatus.description: Order status to report: 0 = Pending, 1 = Paid (default), 2 = Credited.

studentIds.description: Students to include — at least one. An empty list makes the endpoint fail.

name: mhlb_print_orders
